shared_elements: repetition of similar figures across the surface
rows of small repeated marks (pleats/dots vs crew strokes/cupmarks)
justification: The only real overlap is that both surfaces show human figures and repeated small linear marks, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A depicts large, naturalistic, individualised robed and bearded men in profile touching one another in a processional row, while B is dominated by tiny schematic stick figures and numerous crewed boat signs scattered over the surface with a vertical line of dots — no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme.
